environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with no WAF. PostgreSQL 15 on RDS with the application connecting as role 'app_user' which has full SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on all tables. No row-level security policies are enabled on the database. The X-Tenant-ID header is passed through from the ALB without validation. The application uses fmt.Sprintf for query construction.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15, role app_user with GRANT ALL on schema public
